architectures.description: List of architecture configurations for binfmt_misc registration. Each item must contain: name (string, arch name), machine_type (string, typically ':MM' for magic match), endianness (string, ':B:' for big endian, ':L:' for little, ':A:' for either), flags (string, ':PFOE' standard flags), interpreter (string, path to the specific qemu-static binary). See `items` schema below for field details.

register.description: Enable automatic registration of architectures via binfmt_misc on service start.

qemu_user_static_path.description: Path to the main qemu-user-static compatibility symlink or binary.

max_instances.description: Maximum number of concurrent QEMU user-mode instances allowed.
